content:
Before you use IAM Identity Center with Amazon OpenSearch Service you must consider the
following:
• IAM Identity Center is enabled in the account.
• IAM Identity Center is available in your  Region.
• The OpenSearch domain version is 1.3 or later.
• Fine Grained Access Control is enabled on the domain.
• Domain is in the same Region as IAM Identity Center instance.
IAM Identity Center Support for OpenSearch
1392
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
• Domain and OpenSearch application belong to the same AWS account.
